where_to_look: GROW's revenue is almost entirely advisory fees on AUM, and AUM is disclosed monthly on the company's own site and in the ETF sponsors' daily files - so the revenue for the June quarter is essentially knowable before the print. Reconstruct it from JETS/GOAU/USGO fund flows and NAVs through 2026-06-30 (etf.com / fund fact sheets / the company's monthly AUM disclosure)

The fiscal-Q3 EPS restatement announced 2026-06-05 (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/06/05/3307599/0/en/U-S-Global-Investors-Announces-Restatement-of-EPS-for-Q3-2026-Reported-Financial-Strength-Remains-Unchanged.html). A restatement in the year being closed means the 10-K carries the corrected full-year comparatives and any control-deficiency disclosure - that is the one genuinely unpriced document here, and its Item 9A is where it lives
